parts.label: (b)
parts.text: $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ can act as a homogeneous catalyst in the reaction between peroxodisulfate ions ($\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}$) and iodide ions.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: What is meant by a homogeneous catalyst?

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the overall reaction between $\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ and $\text{I}^-\text{(aq)}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest why, in the absence of a catalyst, the activation energy for this reaction is high.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Write two equations to show how $\text{Fe}^{3+}\text{(aq)}$ ions can catalyse the reaction between $\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ ions and $\text{I}^-\text{(aq)}$ ions.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Iron(III) oxide can be reduced to iron metal using carbon monoxide at a temperature of $1000^\circ\text{C}$.

$\text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3\text{(s)} + 3\text{CO(g)} \rightarrow 2\text{Fe(s)} + 3\text{CO}_2\text{(g)}$, $\Delta H^{\ominus}=-43.6\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$.

Some relevant standard entropies are given in the table.
